# Payung

> Liquidation cover for Mezo MUSD borrowers, live on Mezo testnet (chain 31611). A borrower buys one-to-four-week cover in MUSD; if Mezo's BTC price touches the strike, the cover is paid straight into their Mezo loan through `repayMUSDWithSignature` (or to their wallet). MUSD holders fund the cover in an ERC-4626 vault (pyMUSD) and earn the premiums.

The app reads everything live from Mezo testnet. `?address=0x…` shows any wallet's loan, cover and alerts read-only. Nothing in the app asks for a signature without a wallet connected.

## Contracts (Mezo testnet, Sourcify-verified)

- [Payung vault v2](https://explorer.test.mezo.org/address/0x706B5E6F3760eb0c5fe4c726784FbFB269Ac4150): `0x706B5E6F3760eb0c5fe4c726784FbFB269Ac4150`, sells cover now
- [Payung vault v1](https://explorer.test.mezo.org/address/0xdC66559C75c9950f8869e20A04C14494DF601d4d): `0xdC66559C75c9950f8869e20A04C14494DF601d4d`, earlier vault; its cover still pays out until it expires
